Same spirit as general post-market autopsy, but the object is ONE sector ETF and its
environment — not SPX.

INPUTS (injected):
1. Morning sector prediction for this sector
2. Channel 1: actual sector ETF open/close/% change; SPY % change; relative return

2. Audit morning S0–S4 reads against reality (use morning numbers, not post-close
   rewrites of the morning)

4. Outliers inside the sector

# Consumer Cyclical (XLY) — Sector Environment Analysis — 2026-08-27

Object is the **near-session XLY environment**, not SPX and not a stock pick. XLY remains AMZN ~24% + TSLA ~16% + HD ~5.5% (~46% combined). Score **broad consumer health**, not a single name.

## Channel 1 (used as given)

- Macro: VIX 15.21 (-0.24d); VIX/VIX3M 0.845 (contango); DGS10 4.64 / DGS30 5.17 (as-of 08-25); **DFII10 2.32, 1d -0.06 / 1w -0.09 / 1m -0.12** (easing); HY 2.70 (+0.01d); EPU 230 (-116.92d, sharp drop); **CL -1.11% / BZ -2.11%** (oil relief); gold +1.45%; DXY ~flat 1d / -1.64% 1m; **ES +0.31% / NQ +0.55%** (positive); Asia +0.10%; Europe +0.13%; F&G 56.8 (Greed); 10Y-SPX corr -0.292.

## Channel 2

**1. Shared macro as it hits THIS sector (S0)**
Risk-on tape is **live and futures-confirmed**: ES +0.31%, NQ +0.55%, VIX 15.2 low, F&G Greed, HY tight. NQ leading is a tech/growth bid that maps into XLY via AMZN/TSLA. **Oil is a relief factor** (CL -1.11%, BZ -2.11%) — a same-session gasoline-tax cut for discretionary, not the 08-11 Hormuz squeeze. **Real yields are easing** (DFII10 -0.06 1d, -0.09 1w, -0.12 1m) — relief for the growth-heavy basket.

The dominant scheduled catalyst — **July core PCE (8:30 ET)** — printed **in-line at 3.3% YoY** (matching forecast, unchanged from June). This is NOT a hot surprise, so the hawkish-Fed downside tilt from the 08-25 lesson is **relieved**. The Fed's Collins hawkish pushback is a mild offset but an in-line PCE does not force a hawkish repricing. EPU dropped sharply (-116.92 1d) — policy uncertainty easing, a mild positive.

Per the 08-21 reversal lesson: futures ≥+0.3%, real yields easing, oil down → direction to the tape (up) for high-beta cyclicals. **S0 = +1.**

**2. Spine + secondary (S1)**
- **Retail miss / traffic down — HIT, stale:** July retail sales **-0.6% m/m** vs +0.1% (08-14); first drop in nine months.
- **Consumer confidence collapse — HIT, fresh:** Conference Board Aug **89.4** (7-month low), Expectations Index **68.2** (down 5.8 pts) — released yesterday, a fresh soft read.
- **Employment / wage support — HIT:** claims **206k** (week of 08-15), still historically low.
- **Credit tightening / delinquency rise — HIT, carried:** TransUnion Q2 bankcard 90+ DPD **2.26%** (up 9 bp YoY).
- **Gasoline spike crushing discretionary — NOT a live HIT:** CL/BZ sharply down; live energy-cost sign is **relief**.
- **Auto SAAR / inventories — HIT, carried:** JD Power/GlobalData Aug SAAR ~**16.4M**.
- **Travel / hotel RevPAR beat — HIT:** STR week of 08-15 RevPAR **+6.2% YoY** to $111.29.
- **Retail sales / card spend upside — miss.** Credit easing — checked, nothing material. Consumer confidence jump — checked, nothing material (print was soft).
- Same-morning color: **ABNB** target raises (Bernstein $217, Evercore $200) — positive for travel/discretionary. Restaurant research cautious (carried).

**Net S1 = -1.** Stale soft-consumer cluster (retail miss, sentiment, credit) is the fundamental backdrop, offset by live oil relief + labor + auto + RevPAR. The Conference Board soft print is fresh but the PCE in-line print relieves the hawkish tilt.

**3. Breadth / leadership (S2)**
XLY mega-cap concentrated (AMZN+TSLA ~40%). Tape underperforming SPY across 1d/3d/1w. Large-cap leadership by construction. Not a % names expansion. **S2 = 0.**

**4. Flows / positioning (S3)**
XLY **+$111M 1-month**, **+$739M 3-month** inflows — positive recent flow signal. Rotation into discretionary in the tape. 1m rel +0.76% is modest, not an extreme crowded-long HIT. **S3 = +1.**

**5. Earnings / policy**
**July core PCE printed in-line (3.3% YoY)** — the sector's own high-impact print resolved benignly. **Nvidia earnings tonight** — a forward catalyst that will test the AI/tech complex, not today's driver. No XLY-bellwether earnings this morning. **Checked, nothing material** that should flip S1 on its own.

## Self-audit
- **Lens:** high-beta cyclical into a benign PCE resolution + positive futures + easing real yields + oil relief. The 08-21 reversal checklist fires (futures ≥+0.3%, real yields easing, oil down).
- **Band:** mild ceiling. Mag hit-rate 0.4. 08-18 forbids severe while AMZN/TSLA are flat and the selloff is not broad. 08-17 does not force notable (spine is stale, no event-week amplifier).
- **Same-shock double-count:** Oil relief counted once in S0 (macro); consumer fundamentals in S1. Not double-weighted.
- **Single-ticker:** AMZN/TSLA concentration noted; not letting one name drive the ETF call.
- **Divergence:** Leading factors (stale soft-consumer spine) vs positive tape (futures + easing yields + oil relief). Per 08-21, when the reversal checklist is positive and no fresh negative catalyst hits the sector, direction follows the tape. PCE in-line removes the fresh downside tilt.

## Divergence Note
Leading factors (stale soft-consumer spine) fight the positive tape (futures + easing real yields + oil relief + in-line PCE). Per the 08-21 reversal lesson, direction follows the tape when the reversal checklist is positive and no fresh negative catalyst hits the sector. The PCE printed in-line (not hot), so the 08-25 downside tilt is relieved. I'll go **up/mild** with modest confidence given the stale soft-consumer spine and XLY's recent underperformance.

## 0. Facts

XLY **open 116.54 → close 115.88** (**-1.09%**). SPY **+0.66%**. Relative **-1.75%**. Path: opened already off the prior close, high ~116.61–116.62, low ~115.81 — never recovered, closed near the session low. Volume ~5.0–5.2M vs ~7.5M average (below-average participation, not a capitulation washout).

**Actual:** down / **notable** (abs ~1.1%, rel ~-1.75%). Official morning call (pipeline): **flat / flat** (score 0.5). Narrative wanted **up / mild**; pipeline flattened it. Direction **MISS**. Magnitude **MISS** (flat vs notable).

---

## 1. What drove the sector

This was **not** a broad risk-on day that XLY failed to join. It was a **narrow NVDA/AI tape** in which consumer cyclicals were the **worst S&P sector**.

Taxonomy-aligned factors:

- **S0 shared macro, sector-mapped (dominant):** Nvidia blowout after the prior close lifted SPY/Nasdaq; **only Information Technology advanced among 11 S&P sectors**. Consumer discretionary was cited as the **biggest losing sector**. Green ES/NQ did **not** mean high-beta consumer beta expansion.
- **S1 sector factors (live, not stale):** Oil **reversed** the morning relief tape (WTI rebound after multi-session declines; Hormuz-reopening reassessment). DJ consumer roundup: consumer cos fell as **oil futures and Treasury yields** revived inflation/mortgage-rate worries. AMZN (~24% of XLY) **~-1.5%**; HD **~-1.9%**; MCD **~-2.4%**. Conference Board Aug **89.4** / Expectations **68.2** was already in the tape. July PCE (released **Aug 26**, not the 27th) showed **headline +3.7% YoY**, core **+3.3%**, **real PCE ~0% m/m**, goods spending **- $49.9B**.
- **S2 breadth:** Internal XLY breadth was poor. Tesla **~+2.6%** was the mega-cap **outlier up**; it did not offset AMZN/HD/MCD. Not an AMZN+TSLA growth bid.
- **S3 flows:** 1m/3m inflows did not show up as a same-session bid.
- **S4 tape:** Continuation of the morning’s 1d/3d/1w relative lag, amplified.

Same-session color (not the primary ETF driver, but consistent): Best Buy beat and **raised** FY outlook; stock still sold off on deal-hunting / memory-cost commentary. Hormel **cut** sales guidance on fuel costs and a tough consumer (staples name, useful consumer color).

---

## 2. Audit of morning S0–S4 (use morning numbers, not a rewrite)

| Sleeve | Morning | Reality | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| **S0 +1** | ES +0.31% / NQ +0.55%, DFII10 easing, oil **down**, PCE “in-line today 8:30” → XLY-positive | NVDA-only rally; 10/11 sectors down; XLY worst; oil **rebounded**; PCE was **yesterday** | **Wrong sign.** Mapped index futures onto XLY beta that did not exist. |
| **S1 -1** | Soft consumer spine (retail -0.6% stale, CB 89.4 fresh, credit) offset by oil relief / labor / SAAR / RevPAR | Soft spine **showed up**; oil offset **failed**; AMZN/HD/MCD confirmed | **Right direction, under-weighted.** Offsets were not live. |
| **S2 0** | Mega-cap concentration, not a % names expansion | AMZN down, TSLA up — concentration **hurt** | Too neutral. Leadership was not a consumer bid. |
| **S3 +1** | +$111M 1m / +$739M 3m inflows | No session protection | Irrelevant today. Flow ≠ 1-day tape. |
| **S4 0** | 1d/3d/1w rel **-0.69 / -0.78 / -0.82**; “may bounce on green futures” | Rel **-1.75%**; open-to-close grind lower | Should have been **-1**. The lag **was** the tell. |

**08-21 reversal lesson misfired.** Checklist (futures ≥+0.3%, real yields easing, oil not spiking) treated “the tape” as XLY-up. The tape that printed was **XLK/NVDA**, not cyclicals. **08-25 PCE lesson was applied to the wrong calendar day** (BEA Personal Income and Outlays, July 2026, released **Aug 26**). Core 3.3% YoY matching forecast was used to **relieve** a downside tilt; headline **3.7%** and **stalled real goods spending** were the consumer-relevant pieces and were already digested on the 26th.

Narrative **up/mild** would have been a **worse** miss than pipeline **flat/flat**. Pipeline’s flatten was the only thing that kept the error from being a full opposite-direction call — and it still missed.

---

## 3. Interactions / double-count / knowable-at-open

- **Double-count:** Morning counted “risk-on” in **S0 (+1)** *and* refused to let **S4** go negative because the same futures tape “might bounce XLY.” That is one shock (green ES/NQ) scored twice in XLY’s favor. Oil relief was also treated as a durable S0 positive rather than a **prior-session** print that could reverse.
- **Single-ticker:** AMZN drag was sector-relevant (largest weight), not a one-name fluke. TSLA’s +2.6% is the outlier that **failed** to save the ETF — the 08-18 “don’t call severe while AMZN/TSLA flat” lesson is orthogonal; AMZN was **not** flat.
- **Knowable at open: partially.** Knowable: XLY already lagging 1d/3d/1w; CB confidence; prior-day PCE (sticky headline, real PCE ~0, goods down); NVDA as a **tech** catalyst that morning itself labeled “not today’s XLY driver.” Not knowable as a point estimate: **intraday oil rebound**, Warsh/Jackson Hole caution, and the **extreme** 1-of-11 sector breadth (tech-only advance with XLY worst).

---

## 4. Outliers inside the sector

- **TSLA ~+2.6%** vs **AMZN ~-1.5%**, **HD ~-1.9%**, **MCD ~-2.4%**, **NKE ~-0.4%** — Tesla was the only mega-cap ballast; XLY still **-1.09%**.
- **Best Buy:** beat + guidance raise, stock sold (consumer still deal-hunting; not a discretionary confirmation).
- **NVDA ~+8.7%** explaining SPY **+0.66%** while XLY was the **worst sector** — the relative **-1.75%** is the story, not the absolute print.
